title: AI Agents and Tool Use
overview: Build LLM-driven agents that plan, call external tools, observe results, and iterate toward a goal.

method.title: Agent loop
method.body: The model proposes an action, the system executes a tool, and the observation is fed back until the task is done.

method.title: Tool definitions
method.body: Each tool has a name, description, and typed arguments so the model can request it reliably.

method.title: Memory and planning
method.body: Agents keep context across steps and may decompose a goal into sub-tasks.

method.title: Safeguards
method.body: Step limits, argument validation, permission checks, and human approval for risky actions limit damage from errors.

pseudocode:
history = [goal]
for step in range(MAX_STEPS):
    action = llm(history, tools)
    if action.type == 'final': return action.answer
    result = run_tool(action.name, action.args)
    history.append(result)
